org.clafer.ig.Repl.Io

Packages that use Repl.Io
Package
Description
org.clafer.alloy.solve
This package provides the Alloy backend of the solution loop, for temporal models: a port of claferIG that runs Alloy 6.2.0 in the same JVM, finds the traces of a model, reads them from Alloy's XML, and computes unsat cores and their near-misses.
org.clafer.ig
This package provides the solution loop shared by the backends, a port of claferIG's command line: the REPL, the solutions (the instances of a static model from Choco, or the traces of a temporal model from Alloy) and their views.
